epic.title: Launch an owner-ready agency website
epic.objective: Deliver a responsive, accessible site with a verified lead form

tasks.title: Establish content and experience architecture
tasks.objective: Define page hierarchy, journeys, states, and truthful conversion copy
acceptance_criteria: Primary audience, promise, CTA, sections, and form states are documented
No invented proof or unsupported claims are included
verification: Independent product and UX review against the owner brief

tasks.title: Implement the responsive production page
tasks.objective: Build the approved experience in the detected web stack
acceptance_criteria: Core content and CTA are usable from 360 px through large desktop
Lead form exposes validated success and error states
Keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior are supported
verification: Project lint, typecheck, tests, build, and real-browser QA
